name: Weta Workshop Miniature
about: A small figure from Wellington's film-making culture, made under licence and sold as Mini Epics. It reflects the city's role as a home of movie special effects.
tip: Mini Epics are small licensed figures, so check the box says Weta before buying.

name: Wellington Chocolate Factory Bar
about: Bean-to-bar chocolate made in Wellington. Flavours can include New Zealand tastes such as kawakawa, a native plant.
tip: Pick a New Zealand flavour such as kawakawa to try something local.
